info.title: ModelShared (Service)
info.description: Data model containing model dependencies of the clients of the current microservice (WebApp, ServiceTest)

bounds.description: Approximate geographic extent in SI radians, longitude east of Greenwich; not in a non-Greenwich source CRS. West greater than east denotes antimeridian crossing.

constraints: West may exceed east for an antimeridian-crossing extent. Longitude boundaries are not always numeric lower and upper bounds.
A code alone is not globally unique. A provider UUID is not an authority code.
A matching status is not the semantic curation status. Source authority does not imply local executability.

matchScore.description: Unitless search ranking score; not a probability, confidence or scientific accuracy.

order.description: One-based official axis serialization ordinal; no physical unit.

direction.description: Official axis direction. Other includes meridian-qualified polar axes; retain authority CRS identity for exact orientation.

unitToMetre.description: Metres per one original axis unit. Source unit is Unit; target is SI metre. This coefficient is not a projection scale factor.

constraints: UnitToMetre denotes metres per explicitly identified source unit; it is not a projection scale factor.

geographicCoordinate.description: Horizontal latitude/longitude pair in SI radians on the unchanged base datum. Input/output role depends on projection direction.

constraints: No vertical coordinate is implied.

projectedCoordinate.description: Horizontal canonical easting/northing pair in SI metres. Input/output role depends on projection direction.

constraints: No height or depth coordinate is implied.
x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: Canonical grid easting then northing, positive grid east/north and in SI metres, independent of authority serialization and units. Must be enforced before annotation.

gridConvergence.description: Angle in SI radians, clockwise from true/geodetic north to grid north. Null means unavailable. Numerical differentiation does not imply catalogue display precision is accuracy.

constraints: Unavailable is represented separately from zero.
Display precision does not establish convergence calculation accuracy.

DepthChanges.description: Output depth minus input depth for each ordered position, in SI metres; not geoid undulation or physical displacement.

constraints: Not geoid undulation, physical vertical displacement or a vertical-datum correction.
A zero numeric change under a 2D carry-through policy does not establish a transformed height.

MaximumAbsoluteDepthChange.description: Maximum absolute output-minus-input depth change in SI metres; not an error estimate.

constraints: Not geoid undulation, physical vertical displacement or a vertical-datum correction.
A zero numeric change under a 2D carry-through policy does not establish a transformed height.

SelectionToken.description: Opaque expiring provider token binding the selected path to exact ordered inputs and catalogue revisions; re-resolve after changes.

constraints: Not a reusable operation identifier, authority identifier or authentication credential. Re-resolve after expiry or bound-input changes.

CombinedAccuracy.description: Root-sum-square of known operation accuracies in SI metres; null if any is unknown. Not a rigorous error bound or proof of independent uncertainties.

constraints: EarthGeodesy uses root-sum-square of known operation accuracies and returns null if any is unknown.
Root-sum-square aggregation is a provider convention, not proof of independence or a rigorous error bound.

Operations.description: Ordered directed operations; order and applied direction are significant.

constraints: Operation order and direction are significant.
A candidate can be discovered without being executable.

Identifier.description: Authority namespace, code and optional version/URI identifying this definition.

constraints: A code alone is not globally unique. A provider UUID is not an authority code.

SourceCrs.description: Source CRS with its coordinate domain and authority identity.

constraints: A datum identifier alone is not a complete CRS definition.

TargetCrs.description: Target CRS with its coordinate domain and authority identity.

constraints: A datum identifier alone is not a complete CRS definition.

ComponentOperationIdentifiers.description: Ordered authority identities of component operations in a concatenated operation.

constraints: Catalogue availability does not imply that an operation can execute in a particular runtime.

Accuracy.description: Estimated operation accuracy in SI metres; null means unknown, not zero or a guaranteed standard deviation.

constraints: Null means unknown, not zero. No standard-deviation or confidence-level interpretation is implied.

AreaOfUseBounds.description: WGS84/Greenwich geographic bounds in SI radians; west greater than east denotes antimeridian crossing.

constraints: West may exceed east for an antimeridian-crossing extent. Longitude boundaries are not always numeric lower and upper bounds.
Catalogue availability does not imply that an operation can execute in a particular runtime.

ReferenceEllipsoidId.description: Internal catalogue UUID of the reference ellipsoid definition.

Identifier.description: Authority namespace, code and optional version/URI identifying this definition.

constraints: A code alone is not globally unique. A provider UUID is not an authority code.

PrimeMeridianName.description: Name of the meridian defining the datum longitude origin.

PrimeMeridianIdentifier.description: Authority namespace, code and optional version/URI identifying this definition.

constraints: A code alone is not globally unique. A provider UUID is not an authority code.

PrimeMeridianLongitude.description: SI radians east of Greenwich; not longitude measured from the selected datum prime meridian.

constraints: EarthGeodesy expresses this offset east of Greenwich; position longitude is instead measured from the selected datum prime meridian.
Positions are not additive extents.

RealizationEpoch.description: Authority-supplied realization epoch text; not automatically a parsed UTC instant.

constraints: An unparsed provider string is not automatically a UTC timestamp.
An epoch is not an elapsed duration. Decimal years are a representation, not an SI duration unit.

FrameReferenceEpoch.description: Authority-supplied decimal-year frame reference epoch; not a duration or coordinate epoch. Retain the defining authority calendar/time convention; do not infer UTC.

constraints: An epoch is not an elapsed duration. Decimal years are a representation, not an SI duration unit.

AnchorEpoch.description: Authority-supplied decimal-year anchor epoch; not an elapsed duration. Retain the defining authority calendar/time convention.

constraints: An epoch is not an elapsed duration. Decimal years are a representation, not an SI duration unit.

EnsembleAccuracy.description: Stated ensemble accuracy in SI metres; not an operation accuracy or a guaranteed standard deviation.

constraints: Not an operation accuracy, observation uncertainty or guaranteed standard deviation.

MemberDatumIds.description: Internal UUIDs of the ensemble member reference frames.

constraints: An ellipsoid alone does not specify a reference frame.

TranslationX.description: Signed geocentric X translation in SI metres; source/target frames and operation direction define meaning.

constraints: Not a geodetic depth coordinate or a local north-east-down component.

TranslationY.description: Signed geocentric Y translation in SI metres; source/target frames and operation direction define meaning.

constraints: Not a geodetic depth coordinate or a local north-east-down component.

TranslationZ.description: Signed geocentric Z translation in SI metres; source/target frames and operation direction define meaning.

constraints: Not a geodetic depth coordinate or a local north-east-down component.

RotationX.description: Signed geocentric X rotation in SI radians. Custom operations use the position-vector convention.

constraints: Position-vector and coordinate-frame conventions have opposite rotation signs; identify the method before use.

RotationY.description: Signed geocentric Y rotation in SI radians. Custom operations use the position-vector convention.

constraints: Position-vector and coordinate-frame conventions have opposite rotation signs; identify the method before use.

RotationZ.description: Signed geocentric Z rotation in SI radians. Custom operations use the position-vector convention.

constraints: Position-vector and coordinate-frame conventions have opposite rotation signs; identify the method before use.

ScaleDifference.description: Dimensionless increment s in scale factor 1+s, not ppm or the full factor. Zero means no scale change; display precision 1e-12 does not round stored values.

constraints: Scale difference is not the full scale factor. SI value 1e-6 corresponds to one part per million.
Do not apply 0.001 meaningful display precision: it would conceal common geodetic scale differences.
Meaningful display precision is owned by the HelmertScaleDifference quantity; it is not transformation accuracy.

constraints: Null means unknown, not zero. No standard-deviation or confidence-level interpretation is implied.

AreaOfUseBounds.description: WGS84/Greenwich geographic bounds in SI radians; west greater than east denotes antimeridian crossing.

constraints: West may exceed east for an antimeridian-crossing extent. Longitude boundaries are not always numeric lower and upper bounds.

SemiMajorAxis.description: Equatorial semi-major axis in SI metres.

constraints: A semi-axis length is not a radius at an arbitrary latitude.

InverseFlattening.description: Dimensionless inverse flattening 1/f; zero is the provider sphere sentinel, otherwise greater than one. Display precision 1e-9 does not round stored values.

constraints: For a sphere f=0 and its reciprocal is not finite; a finite sentinel must be explicitly documented. EarthGeodesy uses zero as that sentinel.
Meaningful display precision is owned by the InverseFlattening quantity; it does not round stored values or establish ellipsoid accuracy.
